out_of_scope_observations.observation: saveMutations success handler (lines 2462-2467) updates save status and budget but does NOT update editorTripData or call setEditorTripData. This is the upstream cause of the AC8 blocker: even after fix_pass_4 reads editorDay.stage correctly, a successful Approve mutation does not mutate editorTripData.days[n].stage, so editorDay (derived from editorTripData via useMemo) remains at the pre-approve stage value on the same page session.

applySelection() inside CandidatesSidebar (line 2071) contains correct setEditorTripData cross-meal copy logic but is NEVER called anywhere. No call site exists in the file. Candidate drops go through slot-drop handlers -> window.setEditorSelection bridge, never through applySelection. This function is dead code. It should either be wired into the bridge or deleted.

applyBridge (tap-to-select, line 2495) also does NOT copy option objects to editorTripData — only sets editorSelections for the target slot. Same root cause as window.setEditorSelection bridge for AC20.

route_cache.schema.json mode field enum lists ['walk','taxi','metro','bus','transit','car','ferry'] but frontend sends mode: 'driving'. Schema non-conformance only; no runtime crash. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.
fetchRoute .catch() handler at line 2418 sets {status:'error'} without the stale-sequence guard. Race condition edge case. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.

FIX C accommodation stamping (lines 1915-1922) is dead code: condition is Array.isArray(day.accommodation) but PLAN_DATA accommodation is always an object, never an array. Does NOT affect AC17 because KanbanView placed accommodation cards (line 1249) have no onDragStart. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.

spec_section_updates.section_6:
3 blockers remain after fix_pass_4:

BLOCKER 1 (AC8): saveMutations success handler (lines 2462-2467) does not update editorTripData.days[n].stage after Approve mutation succeeds. editorDay is useMemo derived from editorTripData — stays stale at 'draft-options' or 'user-review'. isApproved re-evaluates to false. Button reverts to 'Approve' and re-enables. AC8 requires: 'on success, button shows Approved state and is disabled.'

BLOCKER 2 (AC20): bridge sets editorSelections for both target and origin slot (sidebar checkmark shows). Bridge does NOT copy option object to editorTripData. mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay line 1946 find() returns null when option only exists in source slot's options array — KanbanView card not stamped. applySelection() at line 2071 has correct copy logic but is dead code (no call site). AC20 requires: 'copies option X into dinner slot client-side state (editorTripData) before setting selected_option_id.'

BLOCKER 3 (AC22): isGated=edSlot&&(edSlot.skipped||edSlot.late_arrival_placeholder) returns false when edSlot=null (missing slot). data-droppable='true' set for missing slots. Handler guards are correct — only isGated computation needs fix. AC22 requires data-droppable=false for missing slots.
spec_section_updates.section_7:
fix_pass_5 required fixes (3 targeted changes):

FIX for AC8: Inside saveMutations .then() handler (lines 2462-2467), after stage mutation success: setEditorTripData(prev => { const updated = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prev)); const dayIdx = updated.days.findIndex(d => d.day === dayNum); if (dayIdx >= 0) updated.days[dayIdx].stage = 'user-selected'; return updated; }). Detect stage mutation by checking whether the mutations array contains a stage-type entry.

FIX for AC20: Wire applySelection() (line 2071 — correct setEditorTripData copy logic already implemented) into window.setEditorSelection bridge when originSlotId is provided. Alternatively implement the copy directly in the bridge: (1) look up source option in editorDay.slots[originSlotId].options, (2) call setEditorTripData to insert option into editorTripData.days[n].slots[targetSlot].options, (3) set selected_option_id.

FIX for AC22: At lines 895, 979, 1061, 1143: change const isGated = edSlot && (edSlot.skipped || edSlot.late_arrival_placeholder) TO const isGated = !edSlot || edSlot.skipped || edSlot.late_arrival_placeholder. At line 1282: change const isGated = edAcc && edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder TO const isGated = !edAcc || edAcc.late_arrival_placeholder || edAcc.skipped. Handler guards (onDragOver/onDrop/onClick) are already correct — do NOT modify them.
